english_json: "The children of the Hebrews, bearing olive branches, went to meet the Lord, crying aloud and saying, Hosanna in the highest."

proper: Responsory at the Entrance into the Church
english_json: "When the Lord entered the Holy City the children of the Hebrews, foretelling the resurrection of life, *carrying palm branches, cried out, Hosanna in the highest. ℣. When the populace had heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem, they went out to meet Him. *Carrying palm branches."

proper: Antiphon at the Adoration of the Holy Cross
english_json: "We adore Thy cross, O Lord; we praise and glorify Thy holy resurrection. For behold, by reason of that wood, joy hath come in all the world."

"Glory, praise, and honor to Thee, O Christ, our King!
Hosanna, children winsome to Thee, Redeemer, sing.
℟. Glory, etc.

Thou art the King of Israel, of David's glorious line,
In the name of God Thou comest, Thou blessed King divine.
℟. Glory, etc.

Thy praises loud in heaven each host angelic sings,
And mortal man in unison with all created things.
℟. Glory, etc.

With palms the Hebrew people went forth to meet their King:
Behold, we, too, our homage and prayers and anthems bring.
℟. Glory, etc.

To Thee about to suffer, they paid their debt of praise;
To Thee on throne exalted, we now our voices raise.
℟. Glory, etc.

Their homage Thou acceptedst: accept the hearts we bring,
Who all that's good approvest, Thou good and gracious King.
℟. Glory, etc."
"This day you shall know that the Lord will come, and save us: and in the morning you shall see His glory."
"The glory of the Lord shall be revealed; and all flesh shall see the salvation of our God."
"A light shall shine upon us this day: for Our Lord is born to us; and He shall be called wonderful, God, the prince of peace, the Father of the world to come; of Whose reign there shall be no end."
"A child is born to us, and a Son is given to us: Whose government is upon His shoulder; and His name shall be called the angel of great counsel."
"All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God."
"But it behooves us to glory in the cross of Our Lord Jesus Christ: in Whom is our salvation, life, and resurrection; through Whom we are saved and delivered."
"I am the salvation of the people, saith the Lord: from whatever tribulation they shall cry to Me, I will hear them; and I will be their Lord forever."
